list: official 55 trophies, 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is automatic once the other 54 trophies are on your profile. There is no difficulty requirement, no online mode and no second playthrough to plan for: per GTA Base the list is entirely single-player and free roam keeps going after the credits. The work is volume, not skill. GTA Base puts the platinum at around 200 hours and estimates the post-story checklist at roughly 100 of those. Plan the order as story first, then the character strands while they are still being offered, then the open-world counts, then 100%. Keep cheats off for the whole run, because an active cheat disables trophies and saving until you reload your save.
steps: Finish the story and every character strand before you start the long counts.
Work the 100% checklist from Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the credits.
Leave collectibles, stunts and races for last so you are not re-clearing areas you already drove through.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
KeenGamer platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the mission that opens the game and introduces Jason and Lucia, so this trophy is unmissable. Finish the mission and it pops. Treat it as the start of the story pass rather than a separate chore. The one thing worth doing here is setting up the rest of the list: GTA Base's roadmap recommends turning on every progress and collectible notification in the settings before you leave the opening, because the activities you will pass from now on feed the long counts. KeenGamer also suggests a manual save at the start of each chapter, since GTA 6 has no mission replay and 15 save slots to use.
steps: Play Gone Fishing through to its end.
Before moving on, open the settings and switch on progress and collectible notifications.
Make a manual save in one of the 15 slots so you can come back to this chapter if you need to.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
KeenGamer platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 ends with this trophy. It is the chapter to play slowly, because the list's only known missable interaction sits inside it. After the mission Down to Earth, KeenGamer's roadmap says to find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation when she offers it, then finish the chapter. Skip that and Positive Mental Attitude becomes much harder to complete later. Everything else in Chapter 1 remains open in free roam after the credits, so you do not need to clear optional content before moving on. Pop the trophy by finishing the chapter's last story mission.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 story missions up to and including Down to Earth.
Find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept the balcony meditation.
Finish the rest of the chapter's story missions to unlock the trophy.

sources.label: KeenGamer platinum roadmap
GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 unlocks this trophy when its last story mission is done. The name is written with asterisks in the official list, and it is one of the few names worth leaving exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Nothing in Chapter 2 is known to be missable: GTA Base and KeenGamer both treat everything outside the Chapter 1 balcony meditation as available after the credits. Use the chapter to keep optional strands moving, since GTA Base notes that several character quest lines are only offered for a while. Take on optional missions as they appear rather than saving them for a single late pass.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 story missions.
Accept optional missions and character strands as they appear in the chapter rather than deferring them.
Save manually at the end of the chapter before starting Chapter 3.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
KeenGamer platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: This one lands when Chapter 3's story missions are finished. It is a pure progression trophy, so there is no trick to it and nothing you can lose. Chapter 3 is a good place to start feeding the activity trophies, because GTA Base's roadmap says many character quests and side missions are only offered for a stretch of the story and then stop appearing. Anything you leave here that is not part of 100% still needs doing before the platinum, so it is easier to take strand missions when they are put in front of you. Finish the chapter's story missions to unlock it.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions to the end of the chapter.
Take any character strand or optional mission the chapter offers while it is available.
Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary before moving into Chapter 4.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
GTAside trophy list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 ends with this trophy. By this point you should hold most of the story bronze trophies and the two mission trophies that sit inside the later chapters. Nothing about Chapter 4 is known to be missable, so play it at whatever pace suits you, but keep taking optional content as it appears. GTA Base notes that the game has no mission replay, which means a mission you skip now is a mission you cannot go back to without loading an older save. That is the reason its roadmap recommends manual saves at the start and end of every chapter.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 story missions.
Keep a manual save from before the chapter if you plan to go back for optional content.
Proceed to the final mission only when the strands you care about are done.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of the two gold trophies, and the one you cannot avoid: finish the story's final mission and it unlocks. There is no difficulty setting to worry about and no gold-medal requirement on story missions, which KeenGamer's roadmap calls out explicitly. The only thing that can cost you the trophy is an active cheat, since a cheat turns off trophies and saving until you reload. After the credits the map stays open, which is what makes the last third of the list possible: GTA Base describes free roam continuing with every remaining activity, robbery, collectible and challenge still available.
steps: Finish the final story mission with no cheat active.
Watch the credits through so the save settles into free roam.
Make a fresh manual save in free roam before starting the clean-up.

sources.label: KeenGamer platinum roadmap
GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission in the early part of the game, and finishing it unlocks Trust. It is part of the main line rather than optional content, so you will pass it on the way through Chapter 1. Nothing here can be missed permanently and there is no fail state that locks the trophy. The reason to note it is the timing: it arrives close to the balcony meditation that KeenGamer's roadmap warns about, so it makes a natural checkpoint. Save manually before you move past this stretch, then keep playing the chapter to its end.
steps: Play Breakfast Run as part of the Chapter 1 story line.
Make a manual save once it is done, before the chapter moves on.
Look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, later in the same chapter.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
KeenGamer platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 2 story mission, and completing it unlocks Break the Bank. It is on the main line, so the trophy comes with normal progress and cannot be lost. Heists in GTA 6 also feed the robbery trophies on the wider list, so keep an eye on your robbery count as you go: Maximum Withdrawal wants five bank vaults and A Classic Blitz Play wants an armoured truck, and neither is part of the story. This one is not one of those, so do not expect it to count. Finish the mission and move on.
steps: Play The Cartel Heist as part of the Chapter 2 story line.
Note that story heists do not count toward the five bank vaults the robbery trophy wants.
Save manually after the mission if you are about to leave the chapter.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
GTAside trophy list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is another Chapter 2 story mission, and finishing it pops Family Matters. Like the other chapter missions it is unmissable while you are following the story. The useful habit in this stretch is to keep your optional content ticking over: GTA Base's roadmap asks you to take side content as it shows up because some of it is only offered for a while, and that advice matters most around the middle chapters where the strands start opening. Play the mission, then look at what else the chapter has put on the map before you push the story forward.
steps: Play Child's Play to its end.
Before the next story mission, check the map for new strand or activity markers.
Keep a manual save from the middle of Chapter 2 in case you skip something.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 3 story mission and this trophy arrives when it is done. There is no way to miss it while you are playing the story. This is a good point to check your progress against the long counts, because Chapter 3 is roughly the halfway mark of the campaign and the platinum's schedule assumes you have been picking up activities as you go. GTA Base's roadmap has you doing exactly that rather than leaving everything for the end. Open the 100% checklist once here and see what the mid-story numbers look like.
steps: Play Headliners as part of the Chapter 3 story line.
Open the 100% checklist and compare your activity counts with the targets.
Take any new strand mission the chapter has unlocked before continuing.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
KeenGamer platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission, and finishing it unlocks Hi-Jacked. It is on the main line, so no planning is needed. The airport it is set around is also where Catch Me If You Can happens: that trophy wants an unscheduled departure at VCIA, and it is a free-roam thing you can do separately, before or after the story. If you are already spending time around the airport on this mission, it is worth remembering the location for later rather than expecting the mission itself to award the other trophy.
steps: Play VCIA Takedown to its end.
Note VCIA as the location for the separate Catch Me If You Can trophy.
Save manually after the mission if you are close to the end of the chapter.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 4 story mission and this is the trophy for finishing it. Like the rest of the story set it cannot be missed. It sits late enough that you should already have most of the non-story trophies in progress. If you have been ignoring the long counts, this is the last comfortable point to catch up before the final mission, because the post-story checklist is the longest single stretch of the platinum: GTA Base estimates about 100 hours of clean-up after the credits. Check the activity stats here and decide what needs a dedicated session later, so the clean-up starts with a plan rather than a lap of the map.
steps: Play Operation Savage Glory to its end.
Check which activity and collectible trophies are still at zero before the final mission.
Finish any strand missions the game is still offering in this chapter.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
KeenGamer platinum roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This is the second gold and the hardest trophy on the list. The game tracks it in Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, so you always have a running number to work from. GTA Base lists what makes up the percentage: every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, the underwater discoveries, the shooting ranges, the drone races, Bret's Target Decks and 70 of the 80 challenges, plus the story itself. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app because 200 of those are needed for 100%, and study 100 animals with binoculars. GTA Base puts this stretch at around 100 hours. Do it after the credits, when everything is on the map and nothing else is competing for your time.
steps: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and read the category list.
Work category by category rather than roaming for whatever you spot first.
Check the challenge total against the requirement, which is 70 of the 80, not all 80.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
KeenGamer platinum roadmap
GTAside trophy list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are the vehicle tricks the game counts for you, and the target is 250. This is one of the six silvers and one of the longer single counts on the list, so start it early and let it accumulate while you do other things. The game registers a stunt when you land one, so a deliberate session is more efficient than hoping to pick them up in traffic: find open road, clear runway and a fast car, and repeat what the game already counted as a stunt. GTA Base notes there is no mission replay, so stunts have to come from free roam. Do them after the story when you are not mid-mission.
steps: Check how many stunts the game has already counted before you start farming them.
Pick an open stretch of road with room to land and repeat the stunt types the game registers.
Keep the count in the activity stats so you know how far past 250 you actually are.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
GTAside trophy list

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The requirement is breadth rather than depth: play one round of every activity type the game offers and the trophy unlocks. The count PlayStation tracks is nine activity types. You do not have to win, place or finish well; you have to try each one once. The practical order is to open the map after the credits, look at what markers exist, and take one of each kind as you find them. A fishing challenge and an arcade game are two of the types and both have their own trophies, so start there and work outward. Keep a note of what you have tried so you do not repeat a type by accident.
steps: Open the map and list the activity markers by type.
Play one round of each type without worrying about the result.
Tick off fishing and arcade first, since they also carry their own trophies.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold on every Shooting Range challenge is the requirement, and PlayStation tracks 42 of them. This is a silver and it is one of the more mechanical trophies on the list: each challenge has a fixed target and a fixed score, so gold is a matter of repetition rather than luck. Because the ranges are also part of the 100% checklist, doing them early serves both trophies at once. Do them after the story when you have your weapons and upgrades settled, and treat each range as a short practice loop rather than a single attempt. GTA Base lists the shooting ranges among the 100% categories.
steps: Find every Shooting Range and open the challenge list at each one.
Play each challenge until you hold gold; retry immediately rather than moving on.
Track the total against 42 so you know which ranges still owe you a gold.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
GTAside trophy list

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races appear at 14 locations, and you need first place at each one, not just a finish. That makes it slower than a participation trophy: expect to learn each course before you can win it. Drone races are also one of the 100% categories GTA Base lists, so clearing every location pays twice. Do them after the story so the whole set is on the map. If a course keeps beating you, the usual problem is a corner taken too wide; a clean line beats a fast one on these. Keep a list of the locations you have won so you do not lose track.
steps: Open the map after the credits and mark every Top Fun drone race location.
Win each course, learning the line before pushing for time.
Tick the location off only when you take first place there.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different races, won. Different is the operative word: the game counts distinct race events, so repeating your favourite circuit will not get you there. Street races, drift events and the other race types all appear on the map, and winning is easier once the story is done and you are not racing in a car you cannot afford to lose. Set the difficulty low if the race menu allows it, because the trophy asks for wins, not for clean ones. Keep a written list of which events you have won, since the game's own counter is the only progress display and it is easy to lose track at twenty.
steps: Open the map after the credits and mark the race events, noting which types exist.
Win each distinct event once; do not repeat one you have already won.
Use the easiest settings the event allows to shorten each race.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal offers a fishing challenge during the story, and you need to beat him at it. The challenge is a one-off event rather than a repeatable minigame, so take it when it is offered instead of deferring it. Fishing also counts as one of the activity types Master of None wants, so this kill also helps that trophy. The competition itself is about landing the better catch, not the bigger one, so play it patiently and do not rush casts. If the challenge is no longer being offered, load a save from before you passed it, since the game has no mission replay.
steps: Accept Cal's fishing challenge when it appears rather than putting it off.
Fish patiently through the challenge and beat his total.
Count it toward Master of None as one of the activity types tried.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
KeenGamer platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and finish it. You only need to complete one, not to be good at it: the trophy is for reaching the end of a game, not for a high score. Arcades are one of the activity types Master of None counts as well, so playing one cabinet clears both. If a particular cabinet takes too long, try another; the requirement is one completion, not one specific game. This is one of the cheapest bronze trophies on the list and worth doing early, because it costs a few minutes rather than a session.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in free roam and start a game.
Play it through to its end, ignoring the score.
Count it toward Master of None as one of the activity types tried.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy has a mission strand of his own, and finishing his last mission unlocks this trophy. GTA Base's roadmap describes these character quest lines as offered for a stretch of the game rather than permanently, which is why they belong in the story pass and not the clean-up. Do Andy's missions as they appear instead of banking them for later: if the strand stops being offered, the only way back is an older save, and GTA 6 has no mission replay. The strand does not count toward the 100% checklist on its own, but the trophy does need finishing. Play it to the end.
steps: Pick up Andy's strand when it appears during the story.
Complete his mission line through to the final mission.
Do it before the story ends rather than saving it for free roam.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends with this trophy. Like the other character lines, it is offered for part of the game and then stops, so take his missions while they are on the map. GTA Base names Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret as the quest lines behind this group of trophies and warns that several are only offered for a while. Finish Kenton's final mission to unlock it. If you are already past the point where his strand appears, load a save from before you passed it: without mission replay there is no other route back.
steps: Start Kenton's strand as soon as it appears.
Play his missions through to the final one.
Do not leave the strand open while you push the main story forward.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand and this bronze is yours. Billy is one of the six character lines GTA Base lists as feeding trophies, and the same timing rule applies: the strand is offered for a window of the story, so run it while it is live. Do his missions in sequence rather than interleaving them with long detours, since some strands advance on in-game time. None of the character missions count toward the 100% checklist, which means the only reason to finish them is the trophy, so do not skip them by accident while chasing percentage.
steps: Take Billy's strand when it appears.
Complete his mission line to the final mission.
Check the map after each mission for the next one so the strand does not stall.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full stranger strands, not eight missions: you have to finish each line, not just meet each stranger. GTA Base notes the strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so this one has to be tracked deliberately. The character strands behind Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret are six of the eight, which leaves two more to find in free roam. Take stranger missions whenever a question mark shows up, and finish the strand before moving on. This is a silver and one of the more time-consuming of the six. Do it after the credits when the map is quiet.
steps: Finish all six character strands, which cover six of the eight.
Look for the remaining stranger markers in free roam and finish their lines too.
Keep a written list of completed strands, because the game does not show a clean total.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
GTAside trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand closes out with this trophy. It is one of the six character lines GTA Base names, and the timing advice is the same as for the others: run it during the story, because the strand is only offered for a stretch. Finishing Randy's line also counts as one of the eight strands Strangers & Freaks needs, so the two trophies pull in the same direction. Complete his final mission to unlock it. If you are already past his window, an older manual save is the only way back, since the game has no mission replay.
steps: Accept Randy's strand missions as they appear.
Complete the line through to the final mission.
Count the finished strand toward Strangers & Freaks.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: The last of the six character strands GTA Base lists, and the trophy arrives when Tyrone's final mission is done. Same rules as the rest: take the strand when it is offered, play it through, and do not let it sit while you push the main story. A finished Tyrone strand is another of the eight for Strangers & Freaks. If you are working the list in roadmap order, this is one of the last story-side trophies before the long count begins, so it is the right moment to sweep every character marker off the map at once.
steps: Finish Tyrone's strand while it is being offered.
Sweep the map for any other character strand you have left open.
Count it toward Strangers & Freaks, then move on to the activity counts.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia, right after Down to Earth, is the one spot both GTA Base and KeenGamer flag as potentially missable. Take it before you leave Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The count is the part that caught people out: both GTA Base and KeenGamer single out the Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia as the one potentially missable item on the whole list. After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the invite before you leave the chapter. The remaining spots stay available in free roam, so the rest can wait until after the credits. If you have already passed Chapter 1 without it, load an older save; there is no mission replay to go back with.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning.
Follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation before ending the chapter.
After the credits, visit the remaining meditation spots in free roam to reach 18.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
KeenGamer platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is the sixth character strand, and his line involves hunting. The trophy wants one unique animal, not a species count, so it is a single target rather than a grind. Bret's Target Decks are also a category in the 100% checklist per GTA Base, which makes his strand one of the few that pays twice. Take the hunting mission when he offers it and follow it through. Wildlife study with binoculars is a separate 100% requirement, worth 100 animals, so do not confuse the two: this trophy is the hunt for Bret, not the survey work.
steps: Pick up Bret's strand when it appears.
Take the hunting mission he offers and complete the unique animal target.
Keep Bret's Target Decks in mind separately, since they feed 100% Completion.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Three complete Collectible Card sets, not three cards. Each set is a themed deck you finish by finding its cards across Leonida. GTAside lists this among the silvers that reward long-haul collecting, and that is the right way to think about it: it is a sweep, not a hunt. Turn on collectible notifications before you start, which GTA Base recommends early in its roadmap, because a card you walk past is a card you have to come back for. Do the sweeps after the credits with the map open, one set at a time, so you are not half-finished with three decks at once.
steps: Switch on collectible notifications so missed cards show up.
Pick one set and finish it completely before starting the next.
Repeat for a second and third set to reach the requirement.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
GTAside trophy list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-game app, and the trophy wants 100 locations where you have used it, not 100 presses. The distinction matters: it counts distinct places, so standing still and spamming the button achieves nothing. You will pick a lot of these up naturally, because GTA Base says 200 WAiNK scans are needed for 100% Completion, exactly double the trophy. That makes this one of the few counts you can start in Chapter 1 and let build while you play the story. Use it from the car as you cross the map and the total rises without a dedicated session.
steps: Use WAiNK It whenever you arrive somewhere new, from the start of the story.
Check the count before farming, since 100% Completion already needs 200 scans in total.
After the credits, sweep districts you have barely visited to close the gap to 100.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap
GTAside trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Fifty challenges completed. GTA Base puts the total number of challenges in the game at 80, and 100% Completion needs 70 of them, so this trophy comes along almost for free if you are working toward the gold. Challenges are the small timed and skill tasks the game scatters around the map; they are short and repeatable. Because the requirement for 100% is higher than this trophy's, do not farm separately: work the challenge list toward 70 and this unlocks on the way at 50. Open the challenge menu to see which ones you have already cleared.
steps: Open the challenge list and see how many are already complete.
Work them in district order rather than chasing scattered markers.
Aim for the 70 that 100% Completion needs and this trophy arrives at 50.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Two conditions in one: reach four stars with your partner present, then lose the whole level and get clear. The heat has to drop to nothing, not just below four stars, so plan an escape route before you start. The reliable way to build stars is to keep committing crimes without breaking line of sight, then break it deliberately: a tunnel, a car change and a quiet side street all help. Do not try this during a story mission, since the wanted level behaves differently inside one. Save first, because four stars can end in a hospital visit before you get away.
steps: Make a manual save before you start building a wanted level.
Get to four stars with your partner in the car.
Break line of sight, change vehicle, and wait until the level clears completely.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shop robberies in a row with the wanted level never dropping to zero between them. The chain breaks the moment you go clean, so the trick is to pick three shops close enough to reach while still hot. Scout the route on foot first with no stars up, then run it: rob, drive, rob, drive, rob. Do not stop to fight the police if you can keep moving, because a firefight is what turns three shops into a hospital trip. Keep the wanted level alive but low, and let it clear only after the third robbery has registered.
steps: Scout three shops within a short drive of each other, with no wanted level up.
Rob the first and keep moving to the second without letting the level clear.
Rob the third, then break line of sight and let the level drop.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered when you get in it, so this one accumulates from ordinary play if you make a habit of taking different cars. The target is 100 distinct vehicles. Traffic gives you most of the common ones for free; the rest come from car parks, dealership forecourts, the airport and the marina. Do not bother buying anything for this. Keep a rough count in the vehicle stats and switch cars every time you see one you have not driven. Bicycles, boats and aircraft count too, which is worth knowing when the land vehicles start repeating.
steps: Get into every distinct vehicle you pass rather than driving one car all game.
Cover the airport, marina and dealership forecourts for the rarer models.
Include bicycles, boats and aircraft, which count the same way.

sources.label: GTA Base trophy list and roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time while it is active, and you need five kills inside one activation. Five is a lot for a single window, so the setup matters more than the shooting: you want a group of enemies already in view, in the open, and close enough to reach with the slow-down still running. Gang operations and the larger robberies give you those groups. Waste the first seconds of the focus turning to face the wrong way and you will not reach five. Take the shot at the furthest target first so the near ones are still there when the window is closing.
steps: Pick a fight with a group of five or more enemies in the open.
Activate Combat Focus with all of them in view, not before.
Shoot the furthest target first and work inward as the slowdown runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is the state's airport, and an unscheduled departure means leaving in an aircraft you were not booked on. Get airside, take a plane without permission and get airborne. Doing it quietly is not possible, so expect a wanted level on takeoff; the trophy registers when you are off the ground, not when you land. This is easiest after the story, when nothing else is competing for the runway and you have somewhere to fly to. Save first so a failed takeoff does not cost you anything. It pairs naturally with the aircraft you will want anyway for Whip It Good.
steps: Drive to VCIA and get airside.
Take an aircraft without going through the scheduled flight and get airborne.
Save before you try, since the takeoff will draw police attention.
